blurb: Big Wood Brewery brews a variety of craft beers and hard seltzers available for delivery and pick up at their taproom. They offer private event rental spaces including a taproom area, basement speakeasy, private rooms, outdoor tent, ballroom, and meadow for groups ranging from small to large. The brewery supports local and environmental charities through donations and hosts regular events such as live music and weekly drawings.
